title: Echocardiogram Contract Fee at Hospital Campuses — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Contract rate schedule.** For the echocardiogram (code 93306 under revenue code 0483) on an Observation Stay Account or Emergency Department Visit Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), when its retained value is figured on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Payer class and campus | Echocardiogram fee per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim for services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | 612.00 USD |
| Commercial PPO Claim for services at a hospital campus (Appleton or Neenah) | 655.00 USD |
| otherwise | its charges per counted unit times the payer class's expected allowed percentage |

It is valued at its counted units times that fee, never above its charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Hypothetical cases: Commercial PPO Claim at Appleton, 1 unit, charges 1,800.00 → 655.00. Commercial HMO Claim at Appleton, 1 unit, charges 500.00 → 500.00 (capped). Commercial HMO Claim at Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton → expected allowed percentage of its charges.
